training_plan.intro.text: Teams in the resource slots of a season part, week by week. Drag a team from the list onto the grid, drag a training to move it, or use Suggest. Nothing is saved until you press Save. Rule breaks are shown as warnings and never block a save.

training_plan.no_previous.text: No previous season to copy from

training_plan.read_only.text: You see the saved training plan read only. Availability changes do not change the plan by themselves; an administrator or manager re-runs the suggestion.

training_plan.start_over_confirm.text: Replace the board with a new suggestion? Unsaved changes are lost.

training_plan.suggest_help.text: Suggest keeps what is on the board and fills teams without a training: last season's trainings first, then free resource slots that fit the team's ages, all of its coaches, and the capacity.

training_plan.pool_help.text: Drag a team onto the grid to add a training.

training_plan.no_teams.text: The group has no teams yet.

training_plan.empty.text: No trainings in this week yet.

training_plan.drag_hint.text: Drag a training to move it or its bottom edge to change its end. Drag a team from the list to add one. On touch screens, press and hold before dragging.

training_plan.suggested_none.text: Nothing to suggest: every active team has a training.

training_plan.stale.text: The training plan changed since you opened the board. Discard your changes and try again.

training_plan.saved.text: Training plan saved: {added} added, {moved} moved, {removed} removed.

training_plan.warning.no_coach.text: The team has no coach this season.

training_plan.warning.no_slot.text: No resource slot covers this training.

training_plan.warning.outside_slot.text: The training reaches beyond its resource slot.

training_plan.warning.slot_ages.text: The slot is for {slot_ages}, the team is {team_ages}.

training_plan.warning.slot_full.text: {teams} teams train in the slot at once, it allows {limit}.

training_plan.warning.resource_full.text: {teams} teams use the resource at once, it takes {limit}.

training_plan.warning.team_overlap.text: The team has another training at the same time ({other}).

training_plan.warning.coach_unavailable.text: {coach} is not available at this time.

training_plan.error.invalid_change.text: That position is not on the grid.

training_plan.error.invalid_time.text: A training needs a day and a start before its end, inside one day.

training_plan.error.invalid_week.text: That week does not exist in this part.

training_plan.error.too_large.text: The plan holds too many trainings.

training_plan.error.team_not_found.text: A team on the board no longer exists. Discard your changes and try again.

training_plan.error.resource_not_found.text: A resource on the board no longer exists. Discard your changes and try again.
